hero.title: Power back on.
hero.lede: Tripping breakers, dead outlets and panel upgrades across Austin, with an upfront price. Scroll through one service call, from the breaker tripping to signed off.

stages.c: The kitchen breaker keeps tripping and an outlet smells of burning. We tell you to leave it off.
A licensed electrician is thirty minutes out. You get a text with his name and a live map.
Traced from the panel along the kitchen circuit: a loose neutral has scorched the outlet.
New outlet and box connector, the circuit re-terminated and torqued at the panel.
Insulation and polarity tested on the whole circuit, then the breaker back on under load.
Price as quoted, photos of the fix, and a one-year warranty by email.

fix.title: Tell us what's happening.
fix.sub: Pick what's happening. You'll see what to do right now, roughly what it costs and how fast we can be there. The engineer confirms the price before starting.

problems.hint: Power cuts out in one area
problems.now: Leave the breaker off and unplug everything on that circuit.
Switch that circuit off at the panel and don't use it. If you see smoke, call 911.

problems.hint: No power at one or two
problems.now: Check for a tripped GFCI outlet nearby and press its reset button.

problems.hint: Old panel or not enough space
problems.now: Nothing urgent. We'll come and quote.
Note where you park and how far the panel is.

fix.note: Prices include the first hour and standard parts. Anything more, we tell you before we do it.

prices.title: Upfront pricing, every time.
prices.sub: A fixed call-out, a clear hourly rate, and set prices for the jobs we do every week. Out-of-hours rates are shown, not hidden.

jobs.d: Up to 25 ft from the panel

area.title: Austin and thirty minutes around it.
area.sub: Type your neighborhood or ZIP to see if we cover you and how fast we can get there.

book.title: Pick a window. We text when we're close.
book.sub: Two-hour arrival windows, a text with the engineer's name and a live ETA. No call-out charge if we're late.
